claims.finding: The current fence preserves guest inputs and results while paid features have separate terms. These are representative checks, not exhaustive certification of every tool or its external data.

Native tests confirm the guest signup entry and distinguish Pro/API intents and account-required saves. No real account was created; email delivery, live provider availability and paid entitlement execution were not certified.

browser.networkPolicy: GET/HEAD/OPTIONS only; browser network writes blocked. Synthetic local fixtures; no real signup or payment.
